entries.zh: 勒腰；勒紧腰部、束紧腰带
entries.en: to gird/cinch the waist (tighten one's sash or belt)
entries.notes: 西语栏 desperecar le 为非标准词形（或为 desperezar 一类之讹写），释义以汉字『勒腰』与音写 hic io 为准

entries.zh: 醒；睡醒（亦指清醒、苏醒、酒醒）
entries.en: to wake; to be awake, alert, sober

entries.zh: 睡醒了；困醒了（从睡梦中醒来）
entries.en: to have woken up from sleep; to wake from one's sleep
to wake up and rise (get up from sleep)
entries.notes: 西语栏 'leuantar le dedormitr -' 形迹残损，按 levantarse de dormir（从睡眠中起身）推定

entries.zh: 奋志；振奋志气、发愤立志
entries.en: to rouse one's resolve; to strive with determination
entries.notes: 西语栏 'sin placca' 语义不明，释义据汉字『奋志』与 M/R 音写 hun chy 定
四栏皆空（手稿空行），无从立义

entries.zh: 婚姻；婚配许嫁（昏姻，『昏』古同『婚』）
背弃；违背、抛开（旧识故人）
entries.en: to turn one's back on; to forsake, forget an acquaintance
entries.notes: 官话栏 'gui : Dare goan' 对音含混，释义据汉字『背』（背弃）与西语 olvidar al conocido（忘却旧识）推定

entries.en: to despise; to scorn, hold in contempt

entries.notes: 西语 despreciar（轻慢）与汉字『欺』（欺负、欺瞒）仅部分对应，语义按汉字与音写 guy/gui 定

entries.zh: 不睬；不理不睬、置之不理
entries.en: to ignore, take no notice of; to snub

entries.zh: 舍命；不惜性命（把性命看轻）
entries.en: to make light of one's life; to risk or lay down one's life

entries.notes: 四栏皆空（手稿空行），无从立义

entries.zh: 之后；后来（『后』通『後』；另指皇后、君主之妻）
entries.en: afterwards, later (后/後 also: empress, sovereign's consort)

entries.zh: 阴；阴间（人死后所归之处）
entries.en: the netherworld; the yin realm of the dead (after death)

entries.zh: 后死；后于他人而死（义通『死后』）
entries.en: to die later (than another); after death

entries.zh: 后世；后来的时代（亦指来世、后世世界）
entries.en: posterity, later ages; the world to come, afterlife
